data.name: tools_sharetext_why_title
data.value: Why not just paste it in chat

data.name: tools_sharetext_why_1
data.value: Chat apps wrap long lines, eat indentation, and truncate walls of output.

data.name: tools_sharetext_why_2
data.value: A link expires; a chat message sits in someone's history forever.

data.name: tools_sharetext_why_3
data.value: The content is encrypted in your browser — the server stores bytes it cannot read.

data.name: tools_sharetext_uses_body
data.value: Error logs and stack traces, a config file someone needs to copy verbatim, meeting notes, a long URL list, or any text that is too big for a message box and too small to deserve a document.

data.name: tools_clipboard_what_body
data.value: An online clipboard moves text and images between devices that do not share a clipboard — a work laptop and a personal phone, a remote desktop and the machine in front of you, a colleague on the other side of a chat window. Press Ctrl+V here and the content is uploaded, encrypted in your browser, and turned into a link you can send anywhere.

data.name: tools_clipboard_why_1
data.value: Encrypted in the browser. The key lives in the link fragment and never reaches our servers.

data.name: tools_clipboard_why_2
data.value: It expires. Links auto-delete, so an old paste cannot leak months later.

data.name: tools_clipboard_why_3
data.value: Text reads inline. Small snippets render on the download page with a copy button — no file to open.

data.name: tools_clipboard_why_4
data.value: No account. Paste, copy the link, done.

data.name: tools_clipboard_good_body
data.value: Sending a stack trace to someone without mangling it in chat. Getting a screenshot off a locked-down work machine. Moving a config snippet, an SSH key you are about to rotate, or a wall of log output that a messaging app would truncate.

data.name: tools_images_why_title
data.value: Why images sent through chat go blurry

data.name: tools_images_why_body
data.value: Messaging apps compress images to save bandwidth: they lower resolution, degrade JPEG quality, and strip EXIF data. Screenshots with text show it most — blurry glyphs, jagged edges. With photos of documents, drawings, or camera shots, what is lost can never be recovered.

data.name: tools_images_how_body
data.value: Paste an image (Ctrl+V) or drag a file onto the send page. The file is encrypted right in the browser, then uploaded directly — no compression step. The receiver opens the link and downloads the exact original file — same size, same quality, EXIF intact if the image has it.

data.name: tools_images_diff_1
data.value: No compression, no format conversion. PNG stays PNG, RAW stays RAW.

data.name: tools_images_diff_2
data.value: End-to-end encryption. The key lives in the link; the server cannot read the content.

data.name: tools_images_diff_3
data.value: Links auto-expire. Images do not linger on the internet indefinitely.

data.name: tools_images_diff_4
data.value: No account needed. Paste, copy the link, send.
